PR.title: [VectorCombine] Compose fixed shuffles through widening bitcasts

scope: BlazeFace back W8A8 256×256, batch 1, 1 thread. Same frozen ONNX Runtime session and adapter; switch only the supplied before/after MLAS AVX2 QLinearAdd kernel outside timed blocks. Not a full patched ORT rebuild.

clean_analysis.experiment: BlazeFace back W8A8 256x256, 1 thread, new 60-pair extension only
clean_analysis.effect_definition: R_i=(after elapsed wall / iterations)/(before elapsed wall / iterations); sort R; trim one each tail; mean of 58 R; time reduction=100*(1-mean R), speed ratio=1/mean R. This differs from after_mean/before_mean and from the historical paired geometric statistic.
clean_analysis.bootstrap_definition: Circular consecutive blocks of 2/4/6/10 pairs; starts only at zero-based 0,2,...58; 20,000 resamples per block; trim recomputed inside every resample; percentile 95% interval per block; envelope is a range, not itself a 95% CI.

manifest.protocol_change_reason: Initial contiguous profile A/A had a 16.04% time-local pair excursion with stable sampled clock and CPU/wall near 1. Fine-grained temporal pairing shares short contention episodes across sides; no sample discarded, no threshold loosened.
